label: The offer field is a replay on every run in both arms: replayOffer spawns the checkout own prompt hook after the turn and parses its head, so the field records what that checkout would have offered rather than what the model saw.

The inherited limit line understates the caveat by naming only the off arm: all 400 deduplicated run lines carry an offer answer and none carries an offerError, so the replay succeeded on every turn of both arms.
offerSeen is the only cross-check on the replay and it corroborates it on two runtimes only: model-reported head commands read claude 0, opencode 0, pi 1, devin 3, dsh 2 off and 0, 2, 1, 3, 7 on.

The Claude limit line is true and larger than it suggests: the home CLAUDE.md is a symlink to the operator 27,730-byte AGENTS.md, the runner reads CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR only to locate projects and never sets it for the turn, and the arena CLAUDE.md is the single line @AGENTS.md excluded from git.

The Claude arms carry about ninety times the brief in un-isolated rules text, 27,730 bytes against the 306-byte median brief, so the framework sits twice on claude and only the arena pointer is under the harness control.

Both limit lines have a confirming check that changes no product: one Claude arm with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR pointed at an empty directory compared on the same rows, and offerSeen printed beside offered per row so the replay corroboration becomes a rate.
